## 📝 Description

Please include a summary of the changes made and the motivation behind them. If applicable, reference relevant issue numbers (e.g. `Fixes #123`).

---

## 🎯 Type of Change

- [ ] 🐛 Bug fix (non-breaking change fixing an issue)
- [ ] ✨ New feature (non-breaking change adding functionality)
- [ ] 💥 Breaking change (fix or feature causing existing functionality to not work as expected)
- [ ] 📚 Documentation update
- [ ] ♻️ Refactoring or performance optimization
- [ ] 🧪 Tests (adding or updating test suites)

---

## 🧪 Verification & Testing

Please describe the tests you ran to verify your changes:

- [ ] Ran `pnpm test` (All Vitest unit & integration tests pass)
- [ ] Ran `pnpm run check` (TypeScript type check succeeds with zero errors)
- [ ] Ran `pnpm run build` (Production build compiles cleanly)
- [ ] Verified UI responsiveness and theme compatibility

---

## 🛡️ Security & Quality Checklist

- [ ] My code adheres to the style guidelines of this project
- [ ] I have performed a self-review of my code
- [ ] I have added appropriate tests covering new logic or bug fixes
- [ ] No sensitive credentials or secrets are committed
- [ ] RBAC boundaries and authorization checks are respected
